content.text: Check covers 2025 files, so it included the new one.

I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `178934c 2025-12: add rows`. The commit message starts with the data month, matching how the earlier imports are named.

`scripts/check.sh` passed before the commit. The check only covers files for the year set in `scripts/check.conf`, which is 2025, so the new file was included.

I copied the file rather than moving it, so `inbox/2025-12.csv` is still there. It isn't tracked by git, so you can delete it whenever you like.
